Aisha (CSM): Heads up — Sunnyside (mid-market) dipped ~40% weekly active users. Renewal touch in 6 weeks. Need a focused, fast playbook we can run this week.
Tom (CS Ops): On it. Can we do a compact 10-day re-engagement sequence? Quick checks + targeted enablement + a low-friction incentive.
Priya (Enablement): I can build a 3-piece enablement bundle (20-min call script, 3 x 2-min vids, 1-pager) — turn-key for CSMs.
Jorge (AE): Customer signaled ROI concerns in renewal ping. If usage doesn't recover, we should prepare a time-bound credit offer. Low dollar, high perceived value.
Maya (Data): Pulling the activation funnel now. Initial signal: new seats aren't hitting the activation milestone (feature adoption).
OnboardingBot: New micro-play template spun up: /playbooks/micro-safeguards/Safeguard-Sprint (id: pb_771) :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CSM): Proposed name: "Safeguard Sprint" — 10-day sequence to re-establish value and protect renewal. Keep it narrow and measurable.
Tom (CS Ops): Outline request: what are must-have steps vs optional?
Aisha (CSM): Must-have: Day 0 email + playbook; Day 2 20-min refresher call; Day 4 hands-on screen-share; Day 6 usage pulse + contingency credit offer trigger; Day 9 exec check-in if still below threshold. Optional: targeted in-app nudges.
Priya (Enablement): I'll author the call script and 1-pager today. Will include three quick wins to surface immediate ROI.
Jorge (AE): Drafting credit language: suggest "30-day performance credit up to $X" redeemable if core KPIs not reached. Need legal/finance sign-off but can be low-friction.
Maya (Data): Sharing cohort snapshot: new-seat activation -42%, feature-X events -58%. I'll attach CSV to the ticket. Also recommending an alert rule: if usage doesn't rise 25% within 7 days, escalate.
Aisha (CSM): Action items: Priya -> assets (EOD tomorrow). Tom -> account health + billing/limit check (today). Maya -> cohort + alert (today). Jorge -> credit blurb and T&Cs (tomorrow). I'll run outreach and sequence.
Tom (CS Ops): Quick ops note: tag account with `save_window=true` so renewals and billing suppress auto-escalations. Also add internal note: "Safeguard Sprint - Sunnyside".
Priya (Enablement): Call script snippet for CSMs:
```
Hi <Name>, quick check — what's the one outcome you need this week? Tell me where you got stuck. Let's run a 20-min power-walk and I can share two immediate tweaks to get that done.
Offer: If the fix isn't working, we'll apply a 30-day performance credit of $50 to help you meet the metric.
```
Jorge (AE): Will loop in legal for credit T&Cs. Keeping it simple avoids long approvals.
Maya (Data): I'll create a simple dashboard widget for the CSM with: active seats, activation rate, feature-X events, last 7-day delta.
Aisha (CSM): Scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize messaging and assign copy ownership. If you can't make it, drop comments here. :calendar:
Priya (Enablement): I can make the sync.
Tom (CS Ops): On for that time.
Maya (Data): On as well.
Jorge (AE): I'll join.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — I'm creating ticket now and will mark this as the live playbook instance for Sunnyside.
OnboardingBot: Ticket CS-21988 created and linked to pb_771.
Aisha (CSM): Final note: keep outreach lightweight — email + calendar invite + one 20-min call. We want to reduce friction and demonstrate a fast path to value. :rocket:
